entities.summary: Jacobus Meyer Reinach is a South African professional rugby union player who plays for the URC side Stormers and South Africa national team. His playing position is scrum-half and he is the son of former Springbok winger Jaco Reinach. He was the member of the victorious Springbok team who won at the 2019 Rugby World Cup in Japan, Yokohama.
